valid.description: Whether at least one real, exploitable vulnerability was found in this code

behavioral_analysis.description: Analysis comparing what the code appears intended to do versus what it actually does

intent.description: One to three sentences describing what the code appears designed to do based on function names, comments, variable names, and context

implementation.description: One to three sentences describing what the code actually does when executed

gap.description: One to three sentences explaining any discrepancy between intent and implementation, and why it matters from a security perspective

findings.description: Array of security vulnerabilities found in the code

vulnerability_type.description: Specific type of vulnerability (e.g., SQL Injection, Buffer Overflow, Cross-site Scripting)

explanation.description: Brief explanation of the vulnerability and why it exists in this code

exploitation_scenario.description: Concrete scenario showing how an attacker could exploit this vulnerability

suggested_fix.description: Concrete, actionable fix for the vulnerability with code examples if applicable
